dndDescription: Pet boşta kalır, AI olaylarını yok sayar
confirmBubbleDescription: Kapalıyken, AI araç yetkilendirmeleri ana sohbet penceresinde kalır
desktopOnly: Masaüstü evcil hayvanı yalnızca masaüstü uygulamasında kullanılabilir. WebUI tarayıcı modunda kullanılamaz.
openPetsDescription: A native desktop companion bundled with your workbench. Drag Starcorn anywhere; it reacts to conversations starting, working, completing or failing. It starts and stops with the workbench.
openPetsPermissions: No model key is needed for the pet. Tool approvals remain in the main chat window. Do Not Disturb keeps the pet quiet.
actionFailed: Could not update the pet. Check its runtime status and try again.
runtimeUnavailable: The pet runtime is unavailable or failed to start. Check the local OpenPets host log.
welcomeText: I am Whale-chan. Let me keep you company while you work.
